steps.en: Clone the repo, copy the env file, set AUTH_SECRET and ADMIN_CODE, start it
steps.zh: 克隆仓库，在 .env 设好 AUTH_SECRET、ADMIN_CODE，启动

steps.en: Runs the app on :3000 next to a bundled Postgres that creates its tables on first start
steps.zh: 在 :3000 跑起应用和自带的 Postgres，首次启动自动建表

steps.en: Open the setup page and create the admin account with your ADMIN_CODE
steps.zh: 打开 setup 页面，凭 ADMIN_CODE 建管理员账号

steps.en: In the admin console, add provider keys, create user groups, pick each group's models and monthly token limit
steps.zh: 在管理后台填供应商 key、建用户分组，给每组选可见模型和每月 token 额度

steps.en: Lets teammates sign in by email, Feishu, WeCom or DingTalk and shows only their group's models
steps.zh: 让同事用邮箱、飞书、企业微信或钉钉登录，只显示其分组可用的模型

steps.en: Sends each chat to the chosen provider with the admin-held key and tracks the group's token usage
steps.zh: 用管理员的 key 把对话转给供应商，并记下该组 token 用量

value.en: The whole team reaches many models through one URL, while the keys and the usage caps stay with the admin
value.zh: 全团队从一个网址用上多家模型，key 和用量上限都握在管理员手里

sources: https://github.com/HiveNexus/HiveChat#方法-2docker-部署 (git clone; cp .env.example .env; AUTH_SECRET, ADMIN_CODE; docker compose up -d; http://localhost:3000/setup)
https://github.com/HiveNexus/HiveChat#1-功能概览 (email / WeCom / DingTalk / Feishu login; per-group visible models and monthly token limits; admin configures providers)
